description: "Beyond the Black Waters" by A. L. O. E. is a novel written in the late 19th century. It explores themes of redemption and moral complexity through the lives of expatriates in Moulmein, including newlyweds Oscar and Io Coldstream, as they navigate cultural challenges and personal struggles.
